# Python port of the Activity Localization Imaging code

This directory contains the subset of unmodified upstream functions required
by `utils/ali_pipeline_utils.py`, vendored from
https://github.com/spinaldynamicslab/pyALI at commit
`a348549f1601686c9c4e3bd5fbb7e832c2958502`.

The upstream project is a fork of
https://github.com/Tsai-WenChen/Activity-Localization-Imaging and is licensed
under GPL-3.0; see `LICENSE` in this directory.
